familySummary: Sway rugs bring a multicolour look in Chenillepolyester, offered in two sizes for different room layouts and floor areas.
familyDescription: The Sway rug family is designed in a multicolour palette and made from Chenillepolyester, giving each room a varied visual accent. Its low profile suits placement in living rooms, bedrooms, or other interior areas where a rug can help define a space. Choose between two sizes to match the scale of your room: 160 × 230 × 0.1 cm or 200 × 290 × 0.1 cm. Both versions share the same multicolour appearance and material, with the larger size offering broader floor coverage.
